summary: 25/30 pass. The documentation quality is strong — 100% source file coverage, functional module naming, substantive four-section content per file, and correct INDEX/DETAIL information layering. All failures trace to a single root cause: the MCP server state pointed to the previous (celery) project after analyze_codebase completed for scrapy, causing get_modules, get_function_deps, doc_operation, and submit_analysis to target the wrong project. This forced the agent to improvise without a defined fallback path in the Skill docs, producing two concrete artifacts: (1) INDEX.md uses <!-- module-ref:xxx --> instead of the required <!-- module-index:xxx --> markers (R7, S2), and (2) progress was never persisted in state.json (V6, S5). Fix priority: first fix the MCP project context management in server.py so tools maintain correct project state (eliminates the root condition); second add a 'MCP State Recovery' section to SKILL.md with explicit instructions for the fallback path including exact marker names (closes the Skill gap that caused format deviations).
